summary: Router 0.42.9 addresses TM-15's next action 'log rotation and retention' for the one router file that grew without bound (ADR-0132, proposed). Inspected every append-only writer: state.decisions_append compacts, fallback_observation rotates at FILE_MAX_BYTES, deletion_journal is a small journal that must stay complete (re-applied at start; not rotated, unchanged), auth.audit appended to client_auth.audit_log forever. New optional client_auth.audit_log_max_mib (int 0-4096, 0/absent = no rotation as before) and audit_log_keep (int 1-100, default 5, constant in common.py); _parse_client_auth refuses other types and ranges (bool is not int). auth.rotate_audit_log runs inside audit()'s existing try/except OSError (file system boundary, event still goes to the journal): it checks existence and size first, removes <path>.<keep>, shifts generations with os.replace and renames the full file to .1; the new line opens the file with open_private (0600). Paths come only from the operator's configuration; the log folder belongs to the router account (ADR-0086), so os.replace/os.remove act on names in a folder only the router and root can write; a symlink planted there would be replaced or removed as a link, not followed. Not editable from the web UI (settings.EDITABLE unchanged), so a UI account cannot shrink the audit trail. Opt-in keeps existing installations unchanged; config.example.yaml and config.minimal.yaml set 64 MiB. Residual (TM-08/TM-15): whoever produces many audit lines rotates older ones out sooner; ADR-0057 caps the unauthenticated volume and every line also reaches the journal.

tests.evidence: 4 tests (1 POSIX-only, skipped on Windows, runs in CI on Linux): without a limit no rotation; with 1 MiB / keep 3 five fills leave audit.jsonl and .1-.3, .1 newest, oldest removed, each new line in a new file; 0600 for new and rotated files; the configuration refuses -1, 4097, '64', 1.5, True, keep 0, 101 and '5' (rejected cases) and defaults to 0/5. With auth.py, config.py and common.py from origin/main the rotation and configuration tests fail.
both configurations with the new keys load.

tests.command: every python test/... and tools/... command of all workflows in .github/workflows/, except run_tests.py and check_public_changes (run separately); plus ruff check .
tests.evidence: 95 commands, 0 failed; includes selftest_init (the init configuration), selftest_log_hygiene and check_control_flow.
run after staging this record; synthetic events only.

limitations: Existing installations stay unbounded until audit_log_max_mib is set (or logrotate bounds the file).
No independent audit retention or backup is added; rotated generations are deleted beyond keep.
The 0600 check runs only on POSIX (CI); locally on Windows it is skipped.
